text: PM-Kisan is a central income support scheme for eligible farmer families across India under the Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare.
PM-Kisan benefits include direct income support delivered in periodic financial installments to support small and eligible farmer households with basic agricultural needs.
PM-Kisan eligibility requires a farmer profile, verifiable landholding records, and meeting official age and income criteria. Student status alone does not satisfy PM-Kisan farmer requirements.
PM-Kisan required documents include land record proof (RTC/Khatoni), bank account proof, identity verification, and mobile linkage.
PM-Kisan application steps: 1. Verify landholding data. 2. Visit the official PM-Kisan portal (pmkisan.gov.in) or common service center. 3. Submit application and track status online.
Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY is a national health insurance scheme providing health coverage support for eligible low-income and vulnerable families.
Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY benefits include cashless treatment and hospitalization coverage at empanelled public and private hospitals across India.
Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY eligibility is based on socio-economic records and state family criteria verified through official health authority records.
Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY required documents include ration card, family identity card/ID, and official proof of residence.
Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY application steps: 1. Check beneficiary status on beneficiary.nha.gov.in. 2. Verify family details. 3. Access empanelled hospital network.
Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G) provides rural housing assistance and financial support for eligible houseless and kutcha house households under Ministry of Rural Development.
PMAY-G benefits include financial assistance for pucca house construction, convergence with sanitation (toilet construction), and drinking water linkages.
PMAY-G eligibility requires a rural household profile with verified housing deprivation parameters.
PMAY-G required documents include rural residence proof, income certificate, bank account details, and job card/ID.
PMAY-G application steps: 1. Confirm housing status in Gram Panchayat list. 2. Verify Gram Sabha selection. 3. Track sanction and construction progress on pmayg.nic.in.
National Scholarship Portal (NSP) is a central digital platform for students to discover, apply for, and track central and state government scholarships.
National Scholarship Portal benefits include direct scholarship fee support, financial educational stipends, and a unified application portal for students.

National Scholarship Portal general eligibility requires student status and enrollment in a recognized school or college. Specific income limits and mark thresholds vary by individual scholarship scheme and must be verified on scholarships.gov.in.
National Scholarship Portal required documents include student ID card, income certificate, marksheet, bank passbook, and category certificate where applicable.
National Scholarship Portal application steps: 1. Register on scholarships.gov.in. 2. Select eligible scholarship scheme. 3. Fill student details, upload documents, and submit.
Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) provides clean cooking fuel and LPG gas connection support to women in eligible low-income households.
PM Ujjwala Yojana benefits include deposit-free LPG gas connection, first stove support, and refill subsidy assistance for women in low-income families.
PM Ujjwala Yojana eligibility requires an adult woman belonging to a low-income or vulnerable household without an existing LPG connection.
PM Ujjwala Yojana required documents include ration card, residence proof, bank account details, and family identity declaration.
PM Ujjwala Yojana application steps: 1. Check household eligibility. 2. Visit nearest LPG distributor or apply online at pmuy.gov.in. 3. Submit application and complete verification.
e-Shram is a national database and digital registration platform for unorganized workers, street vendors, domestic workers, and agricultural labourers under Ministry of Labour.
e-Shram benefits include a universal e-Shram worker card with UAN, social security scheme linkage, and accidental insurance coverage support.
e-Shram eligibility requires an unorganized worker aged between 16 and 59 years who is not a member of EPFO/ESIC or an income tax payer.
e-Shram required documents include mobile number, bank account details, and self-declared occupation details.
e-Shram application steps: 1. Visit eshram.gov.in or CSC center. 2. Enter Aadhaar-linked mobile number. 3. Fill occupation details and download UAN card.

scheme_name: Sukanya Samriddhi / Girl Child Savings Support
text: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana is a government-backed small savings financial support scheme for the education and marriage expenses of a girl child.

scheme_name: Sukanya Samriddhi / Girl Child Savings Support
text: Sukanya Samriddhi benefits include high compound interest rate savings, tax benefits, and long-term financial security dedicated to a girl child.

scheme_name: Sukanya Samriddhi / Girl Child Savings Support
text: Sukanya Samriddhi eligibility: Account can be opened by a parent or legal guardian for a girl child below 10 years of age (maximum two accounts per family).

scheme_name: Sukanya Samriddhi / Girl Child Savings Support
text: Sukanya Samriddhi required documents include girl child birth certificate, guardian identity proof (Aadhaar/PAN), address proof, and passport photos.

scheme_name: Sukanya Samriddhi / Girl Child Savings Support
text: Sukanya Samriddhi application steps: 1. Visit designated Post Office or authorized bank branch. 2. Fill account opening form and attach birth certificate. 3. Deposit initial minimum amount.
Krishi Bhagya Karnataka is a Karnataka state government agricultural welfare scheme for dryland farmers to promote sustainable farming and water conservation.
Krishi Bhagya Karnataka benefits include financial subsidies for farm ponds (Krishi Honda), polythene lining, diesel/solar pump sets, micro-irrigation systems, and shade nets.
Krishi Bhagya Karnataka eligibility requires dryland farmer status residing and farming in Karnataka state, verified with local agriculture office land records.
Krishi Bhagya Karnataka required documents include Karnataka land records (Pahani/RTC), farmer ID/registration, bank passbook, and Karnataka residence proof.
Krishi Bhagya Karnataka application steps: 1. Contact local Raitha Samparka Kendra or District Agriculture Office. 2. Submit farm pond application with land records. 3. Complete field inspection.

source: Swachh Bharat Mission - Gramin Official Portal
text: Swachh Bharat Mission - Gramin (SBM-G) is a national rural sanitation scheme supporting household toilet construction and clean village initiatives.

source: Swachh Bharat Mission - Gramin Official Portal
text: Swachh Bharat Mission - Gramin benefits include financial incentive support for individual household latrine (IHHL) construction and community sanitation assets.

source: Swachh Bharat Mission - Gramin Official Portal
text: Swachh Bharat Mission - Gramin eligibility requires rural household status without an existing functional household toilet, subject to Gram Panchayat verification.

source: Swachh Bharat Mission - Gramin Official Portal
text: Swachh Bharat Mission - Gramin required documents include rural residence proof, ration card, bank account details, and Gram Panchayat recommendation.

source: Swachh Bharat Mission - Gramin Official Portal
text: Swachh Bharat Mission - Gramin application steps: 1. Apply at Gram Panchayat office or online via sbm.gov.in. 2. Verify household survey record. 3. Receive construction incentive.
PM Vishwakarma is a central scheme providing holistic end-to-end support to traditional artisans and craftspeople working with hands and tools.

PM Vishwakarma benefits include Vishwakarma Certificate & ID Card, basic and advanced skill training stipend, toolkit incentive up to Rs 15,000, collateral-free credit support, and digital transaction incentives.

PM Vishwakarma eligibility requires an artisan or craftsperson working in one of the 18 eligible traditional trades (carpenter, blacksmith, goldsmith, potter, sculptor, cobbler, tailor, mason, etc.), aged 18+ years, with only one family member eligible.
PM Vishwakarma required documents include trade proof/self-declaration, bank account proof, mobile number, and family details.

PM Vishwakarma application steps: 1. Review trade category on pmvishwakarma.gov.in. 2. Register through Common Service Center (CSC). 3. Complete 3-stage verification (Panchayat/ULB, District, Screening).
Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan (PM-SYM) is a voluntary and contributory pension scheme for unorganized workers to ensure old age protection.
PM-SYM benefits include a guaranteed minimum monthly pension of Rs 3,000 after attaining the age of 60 years, with equal 50:50 contribution by Central Government.
PM-SYM eligibility: Unorganized worker aged 18 to 40 years with monthly income of Rs 15,000 or less, not covered under EPFO/ESIC/NPS or income tax paying.
PM-SYM required documents include auto-debit savings bank account passbook/IFSC and mobile number.
PM-SYM application steps: 1. Visit nearest CSC or self-enroll on maandhan.in. 2. Enter worker details and set auto-debit mandate. 3. Download pension card.
Unique Disability ID (UDID) project creates a national database and disability smart card for Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) under Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities.
UDID card benefits include nationwide single disability certification, streamlined access to central/state disability welfare schemes, educational concessions, and travel concessions.
UDID eligibility requires a person with benchmark disability verified and certified by a competent medical authority.
UDID required documents include photo, identity proof, address proof, and existing disability certificate (if available).
UDID application steps: 1. Register on swavlambancard.gov.in. 2. Fill personal and disability details online. 3. Complete medical assessment at designated hospital to receive UDID card.
